project_name.value: Alder Creek Wastewater Treatment Plant - Phase 2 Upgrades

description.value: During excavation for Clarifier No. 3, unsuitable organic soils were encountered below elevation 412.0. Over-excavate approximately 1,150 CY of unsuitable material, haul off site, and replace with compacted structural fill per the geotechnical memo dated April 14, 2026.
